answer: Why do clone farms stay cheap? Because identity is free to mint. Licensed payroll manager certification with payroll association attestation changes that arithmetic: a certification the association renews after payroll audits, so the echo for each fake is paid in the real world. The check runs before any reward is issued, so a sybil earns nothing for trying; the saffron is that the attacker discovers the price before the first coin, not after. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the nectar of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
